decisions.rationale: Bookkeeping only: the later landed guidance contract supersedes the older EDU-002 request for a visible page-wide Goals panel, and each activity's visible What success looks like region keeps observable criteria. EDU-002 is not reopened and no learner byte changes.
Contract-prescribed disclosure behavior: Escape closes Objectives and returns focus to its summary. No page change.
The per-goal Done indicator is removed by design because objectives are informational under the current contract; topic-bar progress still shows completion. No learner change.
The T25 errors were review-state bookkeeping, cleared by the fresh per-topic coverage and by rebinding the 16 historical high-finding resolutions to the approved bytes. No learner change.
